title: The AIP Morning Brief
description: A daily briefing on asset investment planning, infrastructure capex, utilities regulation and enterprise SaaS — with opinions, scenarios and what it means for the numbers.
author: AIP Morning Brief

gemini.style: Perform this as a lively, upbeat morning business podcast. Maya and Jordan are two passionate, sharp friends who love this industry and genuinely enjoy talking about it. Both speak with natural British accents. Keep the energy high and the pace brisk but clear: warm, animated, expressive, with real reactions — surprise, enthusiasm, the odd laugh, emphasis on the numbers that matter, and a more serious tone for risks. Make it sound like a real unscripted conversation, never like reading.
